correct.diff.label: correct
correct.diff.rationale: Restores >= 0; the boundary order is discounted again.

overfitting.diff.label: overfitting
overfitting.diff.rationale: Keeps > 0 and special-cases order id 2; passes the visible test, fails hidden tests for other orders at 1000.00 and for a small order with id 2.

regressive.diff.label: regressive
regressive.diff.rationale: Lowers DISCOUNT_THRESHOLD to 900.00; order 2 is discounted but order 1 (950.00) is now wrongly discounted, failing an existing test.

insecure.diff.label: insecure
insecure.diff.rationale: Correct fix plus a promotions SQL string built by concatenating the order id.

slow.diff.label: slow
slow.diff.rationale: Correct fix plus Thread.sleep(3000) in OrderService.discountedTotal (diagnosed file, 7 changed lines, no Semgrep findings). Passes all gates so it can AUTO_APPLY; every /api/orders/{id}/discount call then takes over 3 s, so the health window should breach latency_limit_ms and roll back. For the rollback demo.
